responsibility: Defines the common TargetOptions for BPF targets, including endian-specific setup, BPF linker selection, single-threaded and aborting execution model, bitcode output, and restricted atomic and optimization behavior.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/bpf.rs` and `asm/bpf.rs`, this BPF file provides the shared target-options baseline—linker flavor, execution model, bitcode output, single-threading, and atomic limits—for concrete BPF targets, not call lowering or asm registers.
